scope: Valid nonaliasing contexts, stack counters 0 and 19, byte-state fixtures only; natural integration and full storage extent remain unresolved.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Single selected Binary Ninja entry agrees with independent Radare2 CFG and exact angr recovery.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One x86 stack context argument for 4F82B0; no stack arguments for 4F1160; mixed pointer/index EAX return is normalized explicitly.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Offsets and byte/DWORD widths are from retail instructions; fixture values are declared test inputs, not gameplay defaults.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: DWORD +E0, +D8 payload, +108 flag and shared count/stack checked byte-for-byte. The existing 20-element port extent remains a limitation.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Caller retains the 4F1160 call and both mode branches; externally observable native globals retain stack writes in the diagnostic Release image.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Disabled context returns its input pointer and clears four bytes; enabled context returns incremented count. No unsupported null/cap guards retained.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Not applicable: the reviewed entries use integer and byte instructions, with no floating-point computation.
